checks.numberPlusDe: OK — Romanian 'de' linking rule (n%100 in 1..19 → no 'de'; 20–100, 120+ → 'de') implemented via 3-form/4-form plural strings ('{n} de zile', '{n} de tokenuri', '{n} de rezultate'). Number-only placeholders ('Număr maxim de fotografii: {n}', 'Tokenuri donate cu succes: {amount}!', 'tokenuri: {amount}') avoid the 'de' agreement problem by construction.
